exposure: surfactant prescription characteristics (drug selection, dose, time)
cohort: The study included medical data from 846 neonates who underwent surfactant therapy for respiratory distress in Iran in 2018.
finding: The total index of surfactant drug prescription was found to be irrational for 31.47% of neonates, with the dose index being the most frequent reason for irrationality (27.42%).
cross-section timing: Data was collected retrospectively for the year 2018.
